description: Progress tracking, gamification, demo mode, profile settings, and the Netlify proxy. Covers plan Phases 11, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18. Depends on FEAT-001 (data layer, UI) and FEAT-003 (quiz/marks data to display). Features here are the completion layer — charting real data, rewarding the student, and enabling deployment.
steps: PHASE 11 — Progress + Report Card page: Create src/pages/Progress.tsx — Radix Tabs: Overview and Report Card. Create src/components/progress/MasteryHeatmap.tsx — 12-week GitHub-style grid, 7 cols × ~84 cells. Each cell coloured by activity level 0-4 (white/light orange/medium orange/dark orange/deep orange). Data: query db chatMessages and quizResults, group by date(timestamp), count per day, map to 0-4 scale. Custom SVG/div grid, no library needed. Tooltip on hover (Radix Tooltip) showing date and activity. Create src/components/progress/MasteryRadar.tsx — Recharts RadarChart with one PolarAngleAxis per subject from profile.subjects. Data from db chapterMastery (average mastery per subject). If fewer than 3 subjects, show Recharts BarChart instead. ResponsiveContainer, orange Radar fill opacity 0.4, orange stroke. Create src/components/progress/WeakTopicsList.tsx — useLiveQuery on chapterMastery where mastery <60%, sorted ascending. Each row: subject badge, chapter name, mastery percentage bar (progress component), 'Practice now' button (→ /app/study with subject+chapter in URL params). Empty state: 'All caught up! Great work.' with Hoot celebrating. Create src/components/progress/QuizScoreTrend.tsx — Recharts LineChart, last 10 QuizResults by timestamp, x-axis date labels, y-axis 0-100%, orange Line with dots, ReferenceLine at 70% (target). ResponsiveContainer. Create src/components/progress/StatsCounter.tsx — 4 animated counters using Framer Motion useMotionValue + animate to final value over 1.5s on page enter: total study days, quizzes taken, PDFs uploaded, XP earned. Create src/components/progress/ReportCard.tsx — full report card: student name, board, class level, date range (last 30 days), StatsCounter, MasteryRadar (mini), QuizScoreTrend, WeakTopicsList, XPBar. 'Download PDF' button: adds class 'printing' to body, calls window.print(), removes class. Create src/styles/print.css: @media print — white bg, no nav/sidebar/footer visible, .printing shows only #report-card section, clean typography, Thinkr logo at top. Import print.css in src/index.css.

PHASE 14 — Gamification: Create src/components/gamification/XPBar.tsx — horizontal bar: level N label, current XP / next level XP, orange gradient fill, Framer Motion animate width on XP gain. Two variants: compact (Header) and full (Profile). Create src/components/gamification/LevelBadge.tsx — circular badge, gradient ring, level number inside, Framer Motion pop + ring glow animation on level-up (triggered by uiStore). Create src/components/gamification/BadgeGrid.tsx — grid of all 10 badges from xp.ts: earned = full orange colour + name + earned date; unearned = grayscale + '???' name; Radix Tooltip with criteria text on hover. Create src/components/gamification/ConfettiOverlay.tsx — imports canvas-confetti, listens to uiStore.confettiActive, fires confetti({particleCount:150, spread:70, colors:['#FF6B00','#FFFFFF','#FF8A00']}) from origin {x:0.5, y:0.6}, sets uiStore.confettiActive=false after 3s. Create src/components/gamification/AchievementToast.tsx — rendered by toast system: Hoot celebrating (32px), badge name + level title, XP earned, slides from top-right, auto-dismiss 4s. Create src/hooks/useXP.ts — subscribes to db quizResults, flashcards, chatMessages changes (or is called explicitly after each action). On XP update: (1) getLevelFromXP old/new, (2) if new level > old → trigger LevelBadge animation + AchievementToast + confetti, (3) getBadges old/new → trigger AchievementToast for each new badge. Update src/components/layout/Header.tsx to include compact XPBar and streak display. Update xp.ts awardXP stub calls in useChat.ts, useQuiz.ts, useDailyPlan.ts, useFlashcards.ts to actually call db profile.xp += awardXP(action) and persist to Dexie.

PHASE 15 — Demo mode: Create src/lib/demoLLM.ts — mock streamChat matching the same signature as llm.ts streamChat. Contains 5 canned Q&A pairs: (1) photosynthesis explanation with source chip, (2) Pythagoras theorem with KaTeX math, (3) French Revolution summary, (4) MCQ quiz JSON response, (5) marks extraction JSON. Each streams tokens at 50ms intervals using setInterval. Returns sources in the response for chip display. Update src/lib/llm.ts getStreamChatFn() to: import appStore dynamically, return demoLLM.streamChat when appStore.getState().demoMode === true. Enhance src/data/demo.ts seedDemoData(db): creates StudentProfile (Arjun Sharma, Class 9, CBSE, subjects: Math/Science/Social Science/English/Hindi, xp:450, level:3, streak:7, lastStudiedDate: today), 3 PDFDocuments (metadata only, status:'ready', subjects assigned), 5 ChatMessages in 1 session, 2 QuizResults (Math 85%, Science 60%), 1 MarksEntry (5 subjects), DailyPlan for today (4 tasks, 2 done), 10 Flashcards (Math theorems), 3 ChapterMastery records. Add isDemoData: boolean field to PDFDocument, ChatSession, ChatMessage, QuizResult, MarksEntry, DailyPlan, Flashcard schemas in db.ts for selective cleanup. Create src/hooks/useDemoMode.ts — enterDemoMode(): calls seedDemoData(db), sets appStore.demoMode=true; exitDemoMode(): db transaction deleting all records where isDemoData=true, appStore.demoMode=false, navigate to /onboarding. Update src/components/layout/DemoBanner.tsx 'Exit demo' button to call useDemoMode().exitDemoMode() with confirmation Dialog.

PHASE 16 — Profile + Settings: Create src/pages/Profile.tsx — avatar initial badge (first letter of name, orange gradient bg), name/board/class display, sections: Settings, Gamification (XPBar full + BadgeGrid), Data. Create src/components/profile/SettingsForm.tsx — fields: display name (editable input + save), language toggle chips (EN/HI), text size chips (Small/Medium/Large → body CSS class .text-sm/.text-base/.text-lg changing --font-size-base CSS var), reminder time input (type=time), 'Use my own Groq key' Switch + API key input (password type, stored in localStorage key 'thinkr-groq-key', never logged). Board/class re-editable (save → update db profile). Read 'thinkr-groq-key' in llm.ts from localStorage when building fetch headers. Create src/components/profile/DataExportImport.tsx — 'Export progress' button: reads all db tables (profile, quizResults, masteries, marksEntries, flashcards, chatSessions, chatMessages — exclude textChunks and pdfDocuments rawText), serializes to JSON {version:1, exportedAt:ISO, ...tables}, triggers download via URL.createObjectURL + <a> click. 'Import progress' file input: reads JSON, validates version field, confirms dialog, writes to db in a transaction. 'Reset everything' button: destructive confirm Dialog (two-step: 'Are you sure?' + 'Yes, delete everything'), then db.delete() + re-open + localStorage.clear() + navigate to /onboarding.

PHASE 17 — How Thinkr Works page: Create src/pages/HowItWorks.tsx accessible at /app/how-it-works. Create src/components/profile/ArchitectureDiagram.tsx — SVG diagram with 3 zones: (1) Browser box containing icons for PDF.js, Tesseract, MiniSearch, Dexie with label 'Your files stay here' in green. (2) Arrow with label 'Only text snippets →' (Framer Motion pathLength animation on mount). (3) Cloud box: Netlify Function → Groq API + OpenRouter (fallback). Annotation: 'Raw files NEVER leave your device'. Color-coded per trust zone. Tech stack table below: library name, purpose, license. Add link to HowItWorks from Sidebar nav and Profile page. Update AppShell nested routes to include /app/how-it-works → HowItWorks.

PHASE 18 — Netlify edge function: Create netlify/edge-functions/ directory. Create netlify/edge-functions/chat.ts — Netlify Edge Function (Deno-compatible TypeScript, no CommonJS). Export default async function(request: Request): Promise<Response>. Implementation: (1) CORS preflight handling (OPTIONS → 200 with CORS headers). (2) Parse request JSON body: {messages, stream:true, userApiKey?}. (3) In-memory rate limiting: Map<string, {count:number, resetAt:number}> keyed by request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or 'unknown', 10 req/60s window, return 429 with Retry-After on exceed. (4) Build chat completion request: system prompt injected from env vars Deno.env.get('LLM_PRIMARY_MODEL') etc — NEVER expose env vars to client. (5) Try PRIMARY fetch to Deno.env.get('LLM_PRIMARY_BASE_URL')+'/chat/completions' with Authorization: Bearer {userApiKey ?? Deno.env.get('LLM_PRIMARY_API_KEY')}. Stream: use ReadableStream + TransformStream to pipe upstream SSE to response. (6) On 429/5xx from primary: await 1000ms, try FALLBACK with Deno.env.get('LLM_FALLBACK_BASE_URL') and LLM_FALLBACK_API_KEY. (7) Both fail: return JSON {error:'...', code:'both_failed'} 503. Token budget comment: 'Keep messages under 3000 estimated tokens (1 token ≈ 4 chars); proxy does not enforce but client must'). Create netlify.toml — [[edge_functions]] path='/api/chat' function='chat'; [build] command='npm run build' publish='dist'; security headers for all routes. Create .env.example with all 6 env vars with comments. Create tsconfig for edge function if needed (or note edge functions use Deno types).

Export produces a valid JSON file download; Reset navigates to /onboarding
netlify/edge-functions/chat.ts exists and exports a default async function
